title: One extra edge forces Berge pancyclicity
summary: We resolve a question of Bailey, Hollars, Li and Luo. For all sufficiently large $n$, let $r=\lfloor(n-1)/2\rfloor$. We prove that the edges of any Hamiltonian Berge cycle in a simple $n$-vertex $r$-uniform hypergraph, together with any one additional edge, contain Berge cycles of every length from $2$ to $n$. In odd order we prove a stronger prescribed-unused-edge theorem using rigidity of large subsets of odd cyclic groups and an alternating matching exchange.
